Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the treatment of eosinophilic gastrointestinal associated disorders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the treatment of eosinophilic gastrointestinalassociated disorders; adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each health benefit plan offered to public employees and theircovered dependents under this chapter that is not subject to chapter48.43 RCW and that is issued or renewed after December 31, 2015, mustoffer benefits or coverage for medically necessary elemental formula,regardless of delivery method, when a licensed physician or otherhealth care provider with prescriptive authority: (a) Diagnoses a patient with an eosinophilic gastrointestinalassociated disorder; and (b) Orders and supervises the use of the elemental formula. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits a health benefit plan fromrequiring prior authorization or imposing other appropriate utilizationcontrols in approving coverage for medically necessary elementalformula.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each health benefit plan issued or renewed after December 31,2015, must offer benefits or coverage for medically necessary elementalformula, regardless of delivery method, when a licensed physician orother health care provider with prescriptive authority: (a) Diagnoses a patient with an eosinophilic gastrointestinalassociated disorder; and (b) Orders and supervises the use of the elemental formula. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits a health benefit plan fromrequiring prior authorization or imposing other appropriate utilizationcontrols in approving coverage for medically necessary elementalformula.
